what_worked: Power-law concentration slide is well-framed with clear mean-median contrast and supporting histogram.
fix_next: Deck stays at surface-level description—add median-vs-mean per category, provider analysis, B2B/B2C splits, or missingness discussion to generate real insight.
verdict: Clean but shallow tour of top-line stats; lacks analytical depth.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: States $13.5M combined MRR; the dataset's total 30-day revenue is $15.6M—unclear what denominator or field produced $13.5M. Slide 3: Top-10 share stated as 48%; reference is 49.6%. Slide 5: AI category revenue shown as $1.81M; reference total is $2.36M (likely MRR vs 30-day mismatch but no explanation given, and other categories also diverge significantly—e.g., Marketing shown $0.44M vs reference $1.32M).

evidence.insight: Slides 3 and 5 describe concentration and category size but never compare medians across categories, explore why AI leads despite low median, or examine provider infrastructure. No non-obvious finding is surfaced.
evidence.narrative: Slides follow a logical sequence (overview → concentration → categories → geography → M&A → takeaways), but the arc is a descriptive tour rather than building toward a thesis or recommendation.
evidence.framing: Slide 1 sets dataset scope and date clearly. However, 274 missing categories and 241 missing countries are never acknowledged, nor is the 216 zero-revenue cohort discussed.
evidence.accuracy: Total revenue figure ($13.5M) doesn't match reference ($15.6M). Category revenues are systematically lower than reference totals with no explanation. Top-10 share rounded down from 49.6% to 48%. The 48× mean/median ratio is internally consistent with stated figures but those figures themselves are off.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark-green/gold palette, clean card layouts, legible bar charts with direct labels. Histogram on slide 3 is effective. However, every slide uses the same card-and-icon template, creating visual sameness. No annotations or callouts on charts.
evidence.ai_slop: Moderate template repetition with icon-in-circle cards on nearly every slide. Takeaway slide (8) repeats earlier slides verbatim. Trophy icon on slide 4 is decorative filler.
